interpretation: Each referenced file is an independent typed DTCG document. This versioned manifest is a CyberSkill selection/provenance contract, not a DTCG modes extension. It covers one co-located root scope; arbitrary nested scopes, component states, platform font metrics and CSS material composition remain canonical CSS.

inventory.note: Authored portable members include font-relative em values omitted here. Separately classified CSS expressions/identifiers were never portable-root members; every omission is listed for each mode.

normalization.resolvedSourceCss: When this leaf extension is omitted, the exact resolved source CSS equals its css extension; differing source expressions remain explicit.
normalization.aliasValues: Additive kebab aliases reference the existing typed legacy leaf inside the same standalone document; resolved equality is checked during capture.
normalization.gamutMapping: none; OKLAB preserves authored out-of-sRGB mixes
normalization.mixEvaluation: Canonical pure rgb2oklab interpolation of resolved opaque-hex color-mix expressions; CSSOM interpolation numbers are not export inputs
normalization.rem: preserved without assuming a root pixel size
normalization.relativeEm: omitted per token; never converted using a guessed font size

environment.systemTheme: Separate light and dark operating-system branches are captured; never resolve system to a constant.
environment.implicitContrast: No data-cs-contrast: no-preference selects standard, more selects high. Explicit attributes override OS preference.
environment.density: Absent density equals comfortable at root.
environment.style: Portable scalar root tokens resolve identically across liquid-glass (default; absent ≡ liquid-glass) and matte-paper; CSS material composition remains canonical CSS.
